EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}There aren't any houses nearby,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} so
it's the perfect spot {{TAG:0003:0005:}}to build a little
something or grow some flowers.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Como no hay casas cerca de aquí,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}es un buen sitio para plantar flores
y meditar viéndolas crecer.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aucune maison à l'horizon {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}: l'endroit
idéal {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}pour construire quelque chose
ou planter quelques fleurs.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non vedo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} nessun pied-à-terre qui
intorno.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} È il posto perfetto {{TAG:0003:0005:}}per
costruire{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} o per piantare dei fiori.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hier stehen gar keine Häuser, {{TAG:0003:0005:}}also
könnte man hier perfekt einen Baum
oder ein paar Blumen pflanzen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yakınlarda hiç ev yok,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yani burası {{TAG:0003:0005:}}küçük
bir şey inşa etmek ya da çiçek
yetiştirmek için harika bir yer.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I can't wait to see who our new
neighbor is!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope we can swap
books with each other!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non vedo l'ora di scoprire{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} chi sarà
il mio nuovo vicino...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che sia
un amante della lettura!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yeni komşumuzun kim olacağını görmek
için sabırsızlanıyorum!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Umarım
birbirimize kitap ödünç verebiliriz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I try to keep the area around my
house well maintained.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}After all,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} it's
a reflection of myself!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me gusta mantener los alrededores
de mi casa en buenas condiciones.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Son un reflejo de mí misma!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je mets un point d'honneur à ce que
mon jardin soit impeccable. Pas
question qu'on me croie négligente !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cerco di curare{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} l'area intorno al mio
pied-à-terre.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Il nostro giardino
è lo specchio della nostra anima!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich versuche immer, meinen Garten
schön sauber zu halten, {{TAG:0003:0024:}}denn ich will
ja einen guten Eindruck machen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evimin çevresini düzenli tutmaya
çalışıyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Sonuçta,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} insanın çevresi
biraz kendisini yansıtır!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Have you ever gone to {{TAG:0011:0001:0000}}'s
house to hang out?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} I always pick up
decorating tips while I'm there.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Has estado alguna vez en casa
de {{TAG:0011:0001:0000}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} ¡Tiene un buen
gusto increíble para la decoración!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu es déjà all{{TAG:000E:0006:0200E9000400E9006500}} chez {{TAG:0011:0001:0000}} ?
{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sa maison est si bien décorée, ça
me donne toujours plein d'idées !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sei mai andat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} a trovare
{{TAG:0011:0001:0000}} nel suo pied-à-terre?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}È un posto molto chic e io adoooro
andare là e rubare delle idee
per l'arredamento d'interni!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm looking forward to seeing what
kind of house you build!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}But for now,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I hope you enjoy your
camping adventure!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Estoy deseando ver cómo quedará
tu casita. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Por ahora, disfruta de
esta acampada!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu auras bientôt une maison !
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}J'imagine que tu es impatien{{TAG:000E:0006:02007400040074006500}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Mais le camping a du bon aussi :
c'est toujours un peu l'aventure !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sono molto curiosa{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} di vedere
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}come si evolverà il tuo pied-à-terre!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ma per ora lasciamo stare.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Goditi il campeggio più che puoi
e divertiti!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich bin gespannt, wie dein Haus mal
aussehen wird.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bis dahin genießt du
hoffentlich das Zelten!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nasıl bir ev yapacağını görmek
için sabırsızlanıyorum!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ama şimdilik,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kamp
maceranın tadını çıkar!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Your house looks quite comfortable,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}It might get cramped if you own a
lot of stuff,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but {{TAG:0003:0001:}}that just gives you
the motivation to add on later.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu casita parece de lo más
acogedora, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si tienes muchas cosas, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}puede que
se te quede pequeñita, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}pero bueno,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}es cuestión de equilibrio.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est une jolie petite maison que tu
as là, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Elle a l'air très
confortable.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Elle n'est pas immense, c'est vrai,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}mais rien ne t'empêche de l'agrandir
plus tard !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il tuo pied-à-terre sembra molto
confortevole, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Se lo riempi di mobili{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} può diventare
un po' soffocante, ma{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}può anche
stimolarti{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} ad ampliarlo in seguito!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dein Haus sieht richtig gemütlich
aus, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Sicher etwas klein, falls du viele
Möbel hast, aber dann kannst du
ja immer noch expandieren.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evin oldukça rahat görünüyor,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Eşyan çoksa biraz sıkışık
gelebilir,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama {{TAG:0003:0001:}}bu da ileride büyütmek
için güzel bir neden olur.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}One's house is often a reflection
of oneself.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} And you can keep on
improving it!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'm looking forward to seeing what
you do with your place, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu casa es un reflejo de ti mism{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}},
por lo tanto, puedes intentar
mejorarla poco a poco.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Tengo muchas ganas de ver lo
que logras hacer con tu casa,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En regardant une maison,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} on en
apprend beaucoup sur la personne
qui y vit.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Je suis curieuse de voir ce que va
devenir la tienne,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il tuo pied-à-terre è lo specchio
di te stess{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} E anche lui, come te,
può essere piano piano migliorato!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono curiosissimissima di vedere
come diventerà il posto in cui
vivi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ein Haus sagt viel über einen
Menschen aus.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Aber man kann
es immer etwas verbessern!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich bin mal gespannt, was du noch
alles mit deinem Haus anstellen
wirst, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}İnsanın evi çoğu zaman kendisini
yansıtır.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Üstelik onu sürekli
geliştirebilirsin! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Senin evinle neler
yapacağını merak ediyorum, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I heard that you walk up and down
the stairs in your house for
exercise,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Is that true?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I really respect you for always
thinking about your health!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Me han dicho que sueles hacer
ejercicio subiendo y bajando las
escaleras de tu casa, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿es verdad?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Admiro mucho que siempre tengas
presente la importancia de la salud.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il paraît que tu montes et descends
l'escalier pour te maintenir en
forme. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}C'est vrai ?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tu as raison de t'entretenir, rien
n'est plus important que la santé !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ho sentito che sali e scendi le scale
del tuo pied-à-terre molto spesso
per tenerti in forma.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}È vero?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ammiro molto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} la tua costanza{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} e
la tua passione per la vita salutare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mir hat mal jemand gesagt, dass
du bei dir daheim immer die Treppe
rauf und runter läufst, so als Sport.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Stimmt das?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich finde es richtig
gut, dass du immer an deine
Gesundheit denkst und fit bleibst!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Evindeki merdivenleri egzersiz için inip
çıktığını duydum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Doğru
mu? {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sağlığını hep düşünmene gerçekten
saygı duyuyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tents are a great way to connect
with nature,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dormir en una tienda de campaña
es fantástico para conectar con
la naturaleza, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vivere in una tenda{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} è fantastique
per entrare davvero in contatto
con la natura,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ein Zelt ist prima, wenn man nah an
der Natur sein will, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Çadırda yaşamak doğayla bağ kurmanın
harika bir yolu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu rends une petite visite à
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} ?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Ça m'étonnerait pas
qu'{{TAG:000E:0005:040069006C00080065006C006C006500}} songe à agrandir sa maison...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sei qui per far visita {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Scommetto che il suo pied-à-terre
diventerà presto una dimora molto
charmante!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Creo que la casa de {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}
tiene el tamaño perfecto.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ni muy pequeña, ni muy grande.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Sin embargo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}como se siga
comprando muebles, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}va a
tener que ampliarla.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il pied-à-terre di {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} è
delle dimensioni giuste {{TAG:0003:0001:}}per vivere
comodamente {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}e con eleganza!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Comunque, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}se continua ad
accumulare {{TAG:0003:000B:}}così tanti mobili,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}prima
o poi dovrà pensare{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} ad ampliarlo!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Das Haus von {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}hat genau
die richtige Größe, damit es
gemütlich ist.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Aber wenn {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0400650072000600730069006500040065007300}} natürlich noch mehr
Möbel kauft, muss {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0400650072000600730069006500040065007300}} irgendwann
anbauen.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}To live in a house that big,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} must be doing all right
for {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0E00680069006D00730065006C0066000E00680065007200730065006C00660002003000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}It's inspiring me to watch my own
spending and put away more Bells!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Seguro que {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} se ha
esforzado mucho para tener
una casa tan grande.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Viendo el resultado, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}me estoy
animando a ahorrar un poco más.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh bien, pour vivre dans une maison
aussi gigantesque,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} doit
rouler sur l'or !
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ça me donne envie de faire des
économies {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}pour m'offrir un palace
du même acabit !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per vivere {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}in un pied-à-terre così
grande,{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} deve essere
davvero benestante!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Osservare il suo stile di vita
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}mi motiva a risparmiare per poter
vivere anch'io così un giorno!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} muss es aber gut gehen,
wenn {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0400650072000600730069006500040065007300}} in so einem großen Haus
wohnt.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Da bekomme ich auch gleich Lust,
meine Sternis anzusparen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Böyle büyük bir evde yaşadığına göre{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} maddi açıdan fena durumda değil
demek{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0E00680069006D00730065006C0066000E00680065007200730065006C00660002003000}}. {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Bana da harcamalarıma dikkat edip
daha çok Bell biriktirme isteği veriyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}'s house is quite grand,
isn't it?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I bet the view from the second floor
is breathtaking.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm a little envious,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Qué grande es la casa de
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿no te parece?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Seguro que las vistas desde el
segundo piso son preciosísimas!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Me da un poco de envidia y todo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu as vu la maison {{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} ?
Elle est immense !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}On doit avoir une vue sensationnelle
depuis l'étage... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ah, ça ! Il y en a qui
ont de la chance ! {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il pied-à-terre di {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}è magnifique, n'est-ce pas?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Immagino che la vista dal primo
piano sia davvero mozzafiato.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Uaaau, che invidia{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das Haus von {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} ist ganz
schön beeindruckend...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Bestimmt ist die Aussicht von ganz
oben auch toll...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Oh, da werde ich
richtig neidisch, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}'in evi gerçekten görkemli,
değil mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}İkinci kattaki manzara nefes
kesicidir kesin.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Biraz kıskandım
doğrusu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}When I walk down to the beach,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'm
often so entranced by the ocean
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}that I almost fall off the path.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Please make sure you watch where
you step,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cuando bajo la cuesta que lleva
a la playa, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}noto como el mar me
hipnotiza.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tal es el efecto que tiene en mí
la naturaleza, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}À la mer, je suis si fascinée par le
spectacle des vagues {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}que j'en oublie
de regarder où je mets les pieds !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}On a vite fait de se retrouver le nez
dans le sable ! Alors fais attention
quand tu marches, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando scendo giù per la discesa
che porta in spiaggia,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}sono come
rapita dalla bellezza del mare...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}... e spesso rischio di capitombolare!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mi raccomando, guarda sempre
dove metti i piedi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das Meer ist wirklich toll...
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich liebe es, wenn das Wasser
in der Ferne aufblitzt...
Einmal war ich so in Träumereien
versunken, {{TAG:0003:000D:}}dass ich fast die Rampe
zum Strand runtergekullert wäre!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Also pass gut auf, wenn du
spazieren gehst, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die Welt ist voller Tücken, hihi...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sahile inerken{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}} bazen denize öyle
dalıyorum ki{{TAG:0003:000D:}} neredeyse patikadan aşağı
düşeceğim. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sen de adımlarına dikkat
et,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I go to Re-Tail to sell the things
I don't need anymore.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Then I use the
money to buy new stuff!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Suelo ir a Reciclaje Bártulos para
deshacerme de las cosas que ya
no necesito.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Con el dinero que saco, puedo
comprar otros artículos que sí
que me hacen falta!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je vais souvent au magasin de
recyclage pour vendre ce dont
je n'ai plus besoin.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Et avec l'argent ainsi récupéré,
je peux m'acheter plein de nouvelles{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
choses ! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Eh oui : y'en a, là-dedans !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spesso vado da {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ricicla e Ricrea{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} a
vendere le cose che non mi servono.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Poi con quei soldi ne compro altre!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich gehe oft zur Fundgrube und
verkaufe Kram, den ich nicht mehr
brauche.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Und von den Sternis kaufe ich mir
dann sofort wieder neuen Kram!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} artık ihtiyacım olmayan şeyleri
Re-Tail'de satıyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sonra kazandığım
parayla yeni şeyler alıyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Since {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Cyrus{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} at Re-Tail does
customization,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}I can take my
old furniture...
and have it remade in a completely
different style!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's fun to make
my old things look new again.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ahora que han ampliado la tienda
de reciclaje, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}se me ha abierto
todo un mundo de posibilidades.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Puedo llevar un mueble viejo y
que me lo rehagan con otro estilo!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Aaah{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Estas cosas me encantan.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Maintenant que le magasin de
recyclage s'est agrandi, je peux y
apporter mes vieux meubles...
... pour leur offrir une seconde
jeunesse ! {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Un peu de nouveauté
ne fait jamais de mal.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Adoooro portare a {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Merino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} le mie
cose vecchie{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} per rimodernarle
o cambiarne lo stile!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}È così bello{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} dare agli oggetti
del passato un'altra possibilità, no?!
DE:
